H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)

H5982: a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform
H7651: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
H2874: properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter)
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H6186: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
H7979: a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1610: the back; by extension the body or self
H4791: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H2008: hither or thither (but used both of place and time)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H3898: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)

H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H833: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H3256: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
H3887: properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H3198: to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H3971: to stain; a blemish (physically or morally)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

H3254: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
H3948: properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement
H3374: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6918: sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not

H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses

H3678: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)

H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen

H4985: to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)

H7496: properly, lax, i.e. (figuratively) a ghost (as dead; in plural only)
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
